description:
Finalize the 'Monthly Business Review' presentation for external distribution. 

1. Break the link to the external 'financial_data.ods' spreadsheet on Slide 2 so the data is embedded and portable. (Go to Edit > Links to External Files, select the link, and click Break Link).
2. Remove the 'Confidential - Internal Use Only' text watermark from the Slide Master so it no longer appears on any slide. (Go to View > Slide Master, select and delete the text box at the bottom).
3. Save the presentation.
